about.p1: MemoryCare is the trading name of MemoryCare LLC, a company registered in Yerevan, Armenia in 2026. We look after family plots in the city’s cemeteries under a yearly subscription or as a single visit, and after every visit we send a report: eight photographs, two short videos, a GPS point recorded at the plot, and the crew’s written note on what they found and what they did.
about.p2: We sell five things: a single inspection, a single full visit, four full visits a year, six, and non-standard care by arrangement. Every visit is a full visit — the whole plot and every monument, cleaned — and no visit closes until the GPS point, eight photographs and two videos exist. The price list is published, the formula for a larger plot is published, and one list applies in Yerevan and in Los Angeles.
about.why: The care is not the scarce thing: plenty of people in Yerevan can clear a plot. What is scarce is knowing it was done, by whom and on what day, when you cannot go and look. So what we built is the record: a GPS point at the plot, the same four angles before and after, a report you can forward.

home.faq.a1: Yes. The cemetery, the district or just the city is enough, and “not sure” is a valid answer on our form. Finding the plot is the first thing an inspection does: we locate it, record its GPS point, photograph and film its condition, and send you a written inventory with a price for the work it needs.
home.faq.a2: The winter visit runs on the days the weather allows rather than on a fixed date, because the limit is temperature: washing stone at or below +4…+10 °C, or with a frost due within 48 hours, damages it. If no such day comes all winter, the winter visit is added to spring. Four full visits either way. That is a term of the contract.
home.faq.a3: We tell you the same day, with the crew’s account of why — a funeral, a closed section, a dispute about access. The visit is not lost and it does not come out of your year. We go back, and you have the new date before you have to ask for it.
home.faq.a4: Yes. Family Circle is part of every annual subscription. You invite relatives by email or WhatsApp, and they see every report from the first one, with nothing to pay and no subscription of their own. Prices, invoices and the renewal date stay visible to you alone. A report can also be forwarded as a plain link that needs no account.
home.faq.a5: Yes. Tell us in advance and we agree a time. A relative in Yerevan can meet the crew instead of you, without an account and without an invitation, and they never see a price. Leave their name and number in the note field on the form.
home.faq.a6: We call or write within one business day, Yerevan business hours, 09:00–18:00 (UTC+4). Hayk writes on WhatsApp from +374 93 154 108 first and calls only if you would rather talk. The conversation is about your plot and what it needs. Nothing is sold in it, and it costs nothing to have it.

how.crew: Your plot is looked after by the same assigned crew.
how.firstVisit: The first visit of a subscription is a full visit like every other, and usually the longest, because a plot nobody has worked on takes longer. It is not a survey: the inspection is the survey, and a separate product.
how.h1: How grave care in Yerevan works
how.includes.1: The whole plot and every monument on it, every time.
how.includes.2: Steam cleaning of the stone, with a steam generator.
how.includes.4: Soft brushes and plastic scrapers only. No wire, ever.
how.includes.5: pH-neutral products, chosen for the stone under them.
how.includes.6: Weeding, clearing, levelling, and the rubbish taken away.
how.includes.7: High pressure for paths and railings, not for monuments.
how.includes.8: A tripod, so the before and after angles match.
how.notdo.1: No chlorine and no acid, on any stone, for any reason.
how.notdo.2: No repairs or construction without the municipality’s permission.
how.notdo.3: No work on a neighbouring plot, and no other grave in a photograph.
how.notdo.4: No painting, re-lettering or moving part of a monument without agreeing it first.
how.notdo.link: The full list, on the limitations page
how.overclean: We do not steam a monument that does not need it. Cleaning stone harder than it needs is how stone gets damaged, and on tuf it cannot be undone.
how.standfirst: What happens, in what order, and what we do not do. No account is needed to read this.
how.step1.body: You send three fields, or write on WhatsApp. We call or write within one business day, Yerevan business hours, 09:00–18:00 (UTC+4). The conversation is about the plot: where it is, what is on it, what condition it is in. Nothing is signed on that call.
how.step1.heading: You ask
how.step2.body: Yerevan’s cemeteries are not usefully mapped, so this comes first. We locate the plot and record its GPS point; every crew after that goes to those coordinates. If you do not know exactly where it is, this answers it.
how.step2.heading: We find the plot
how.step3.body: Before the work: the GPS point, four photographs from four fixed angles, and a walk-round video of 20–40 seconds. Then the work, on the whole plot and every monument. Then the same four angles, and the second video.
how.step3.heading: The crew visits
how.step4.body: Your report arrives within 48 hours: eight photographs, two videos, the GPS point, the date and time, and the crew’s note. It arrives as a link you can forward, and whoever opens it needs no account.
how.step4.heading: The report reaches you
how.weather: Stone cannot be washed at or below +4…+10 °C, or with a frost due within 48 hours: water in the pores freezes and splits the surface from inside, and the damage shows two years later rather than the same day. So we do not promise the date of the winter visit in advance. It runs on the days the weather allows, and we confirm the date with you a few days ahead. If no such day comes all winter, that visit is not lost and it is not replaced with something smaller: it is added to spring, and spring has two visits. Four full visits, whatever the winter does. It is a term of the contract, not an exception to it.

legal.cookies.p1: This is a separate document from the privacy policy, because what a site stores on your device is a separate question from what a company holds about you.
legal.cookies.p2: These pages set no advertising cookies and no analytics cookies. There is no tracking pixel, no advertising network tag, and no third-party script that follows you to another site. That is why you are not asked to accept anything when you arrive.
legal.cookies.p3: Two things do store something, and both are strictly necessary. Choosing a language stores that choice on your own device so the site opens in it next time. Signing in to the client portal creates a session cookie that keeps you signed in and ends when you sign out.
legal.cookies.p4: When you send the consultation form, what you typed is sent to us together with the page you came from. That is a transfer of data, not a cookie, and it is covered by the privacy policy and by the consent line on the form itself.
legal.cookies.p5: You can delete or block cookies in your browser at any time. Blocking the two above means the site forgets your language and the portal cannot keep you signed in; nothing else on these pages changes.
legal.cookies.p6: If we ever add measurement or an embedded map, we will ask you first and this page will say what was added and when.

legal.limitations.access.p1: There are no cemetery operators in Armenia; the municipality performs that function. We work on a plot on the authority of the person who holds the right to it, and that permission is a separate, explicit confirmation you give when you order — not a line buried in a contract.
legal.limitations.access.p2: If you are not the holder of that right — you are a grandchild, or the plot stands in the name of the person buried in it — tell us before you order. We will say what we can do.
legal.limitations.ask.1: We do not move, lift or re-set any part of a monument.
legal.limitations.ask.2: We do not paint, coat or re-letter a monument.
legal.limitations.ask.3: We do not fell trees or work on a neighbouring plot.
legal.limitations.ask.4: We do not use chlorine or acid on any stone, ever.
legal.limitations.ask.5: We do not pressure-wash a monument.
legal.limitations.ask.6: We do not steam a monument that does not need it.
legal.limitations.ask.h2: What we will not do without asking you first
legal.limitations.construction.blocked: [the written boundary of what counts as minor repair is with our lawyer — until it exists we name no repair we will perform]
legal.limitations.construction.p1: Cleaning and care need nobody’s permission but yours. Construction work on a plot does. Building, installing, replacing, re-setting or removing any structural element of a grave requires permission from the municipality, and we do not carry out that kind of work under a care subscription.
legal.limitations.construction.p2: What we do under a subscription is care: cleaning, washing, weeding, clearing, levelling loose ground, seasonal work and waste removal.
legal.limitations.construction.p3: An inspection may include a written quote for minor repair. That quote is an offer for a separate, itemised job — never part of a subscription, never started without your written approval, and never started where a municipal permission is required until that permission exists.
legal.limitations.h1: What we do not and cannot do

legal.limitations.liability.h2: Limits on what we can promise
legal.limitations.notus.p1: We are not a funeral service, a monument workshop, a cemetery administration or a burial-records office. We do not sell plots and we do not arrange burials.
legal.limitations.notus.p2: In English, “memory care” usually means care for people living with dementia. That is not what this company does. We look after graves.
legal.limitations.photo.blocked: [the consent form itself is being drafted by our lawyer — no client photograph is used anywhere until it exists]
legal.limitations.photo.p1: Photographs and video of your plot are the product, and they are made on every visit. Publishing any of them anywhere outside your own report and your own Family Circle requires your separate written consent, given case by case. We do not deliberately photograph other people’s graves or other visitors.
legal.limitations.standfirst: Some of these are limits we set ourselves, and some are limits the law and the cemetery set for us. It is easier to read them before you order.
legal.limitations.stone: Yerevan’s stone is granite, lalvar, basalt and tuf. Chlorine and acid destroy all four from inside: the salts crystallise in the pores and split the surface. Over-cleaning is damage, and on tuf it cannot be undone.
legal.privacy.changes.p1: If we change this policy we will change the date at the top, and if the change affects what we do with your data we will tell clients by email before it takes effect.
legal.privacy.collect.cards: Card numbers never reach us. A card payment is entered on the bank’s own payment page and we never see, hold or store the number.
legal.privacy.collect.client: If you become a client we additionally hold: your email address, for signing in and for report notifications; the cemetery, sector and plot number of the plot we look after, and its GPS coordinates; photographs and video of the plot and its monuments, made on every visit, and the crew’s written notes; the GPS point recorded by the crew at each visit, with its date and time; your payment record — what you paid, when, and by what method; and the names and contact details of anyone you invite into your Family Circle.
legal.privacy.collect.consultation: If you only ask for a consultation, we hold your name, your phone number or email address, the cemetery or city you named, your preferred language, anything you chose to write in the note field, and which page you came from. That is the entire form. We do not ask for your address or your family’s names before we have spoken.
legal.privacy.name.h2: The name of the person buried in the plot
legal.privacy.name.p1: A report shows the cemetery, the sector and the plot number. The name of the person buried there is not shown unless you switch it on. It is off by default, the setting belongs to the plot, and turning it off again also removes the name from report links that have already been shared.
legal.privacy.name.p2: We do this because a report link travels — into a family group chat, to relatives without accounts — and because part of our audience lives where that kind of data is protected by law.
legal.privacy.notdo.p1: We do not sell your data. We do not share it with advertisers. We do not use photographs of your plot in any marketing, on any channel, without your separate written consent given for that purpose. We do not use your data to make automated decisions about you.

legal.refund.base.h2: Why the base is the amount you paid
legal.refund.base.p1: If you started with an inspection or a single visit, its price was credited into your subscription, so the amount you actually paid was less than the list price. The refund is calculated from what left your account, not from the list price. Calculating it the other way would return you more than you ever gave us, which would not make the policy generous — it would make it wrong.
legal.refund.cancel.line: You paid {paid} ֏. {done} of {total} visits are done. Refund: {paid} × {left} ÷ {total} = {result} ֏
legal.refund.cancel.p1: Cancellation is done in your account, without telephoning us. The arithmetic above is shown on screen, with your own numbers in it, before you confirm anything.
legal.refund.cancel.p2: Your existing reports stay available to you after cancellation. They are read-only; there are no further visits, and we will not advertise to you on those screens.
legal.refund.example1.paid: You paid 95,000 ֏ AMD (160,000 less the 65,000 credit)
legal.refund.example1.title: Four visits a year, entered through a single visit
legal.refund.example2.title: Four visits a year, bought outright

legal.refund.how.blocked: [the number of business days is set by our bank’s acquiring terms and will be printed here once they are in force]
legal.refund.how.h2: How and when the money comes back
legal.refund.how.p1: Refunds are returned to the account the payment came from.
legal.refund.oneoff.blocked: [the rule for cancelling an inspection or a single visit before it is carried out is being set by the owner and will be printed here]
legal.refund.rule.formula: refund = the amount you paid × visits not performed ÷ visits in your plan
legal.refund.rule.p1: You can cancel an annual subscription at any time. We refund the visits you have paid for and not received.
legal.refund.rule.rounding: Rounded up to the nearest 100 ֏, in your favour. There is no upper limit on the refund.
legal.refund.standfirst: You can cancel a subscription at any time and get back the part of the year you have not received. Here is exactly how that is calculated.
legal.refund.unhappy.h2: If you are unhappy with a report
legal.refund.unhappy.p1: If a report shows work that was not done properly, tell us and we return and redo the visit at our cost. The window is seven days from the moment the report reaches you, not from the date of the visit. This is a repeat visit rather than a refund. If you would rather cancel, the rule above applies.
legal.refund.visits.p1: Because you can count visits yourself. A month-based calculation would tell a client who has had one visit out of four that they have used up 27% of the year, and there would be nothing they could check. Work already done is already paid for; everything else comes back.
legal.security.p1: The connection between your browser and this site is encrypted, and we hold the certificate that proves it. Anything you type into the form travels encrypted.
legal.security.p2: We do not store card numbers. When card payment is enabled, the card details are entered on the bank’s own payment page, not on ours. We receive confirmation that a payment succeeded, the amount and the date — never the number.
legal.security.p3: We will never ask you for your bank account number, and we may not use it for anything other than accepting a payment. If anyone asks you for it in our name, it is not us.
legal.security.p4: A card payment is never accepted against a debt incurred earlier. You pay for a service before it is delivered, or you do not pay at all.
legal.security.p5: What we do store is your name, your phone number and email address, the plot we look after, the reports, and the record of what you paid. That list, and who else can see it, is in the privacy policy.
legal.terms.after.p1: A GPS point recorded by the crew standing at your plot, on the day. Eight photographs: four fixed angles before the work and the same four from the same points after it. Two videos of 20 to 40 seconds, before and after. The crew’s written note. Your visit cannot be closed in our system without every one of those.
legal.terms.after.p2: If you asked for it, the report also arrives as a plain link you can forward to family who have no account. If you asked for it, we tell you the day before a visit — and we can tell someone else instead, such as a relative in Yerevan.
legal.terms.complaints.p1: If anything is damaged during a visit, we photograph it, and we call the coordinator and then you within 24 hours, with a plan. Anything else: info@memorycare.am, or Hayk Manukyan, +374 93 154 108.
legal.terms.credit.h2: The credit, and the conditions on it
legal.terms.credit.p1: An inspection at 20,000 ֏ AMD is credited only when you sign an annual subscription, and only within 60 days of the inspection. It is never credited into a single visit. A single visit at 65,000 ֏ AMD is credited in full into an annual subscription taken within 60 days. Only one credit applies: if you have paid for both, the larger of the two is credited and the inspection remains a paid inspection. There is no reduced price for a repeat single visit.
legal.terms.credit.p2: This is a credit and not a trial. Nothing renews by itself, nothing is charged automatically at the end of a period, and there is no free or preferential trial of any kind on this service.
legal.terms.crew.p1: Your plot is looked after by the same assigned crew.
legal.terms.guarantees.p1: If you are unhappy with a report, we return and redo the visit at our cost. The seven days run from the moment the report reaches you, not from the date of the visit, so a late report cannot shorten the window.
legal.terms.guarantees.p2: A pro-rata refund on cancellation, as set out in the refund policy.
legal.terms.payment.p1: You can pay by bank transfer today. Card payment is being enabled with our bank and we do not promise a date for it. The price is the same either way: there is no surcharge and no different condition for paying by card.
legal.terms.payment.p2: Transactions made inside Armenia are made in Armenian drams. All our prices are quoted in drams and every charge is made in drams.
legal.terms.sequence.1: You send a consultation request. No payment, no account.
legal.terms.sequence.2: We call or write within one business day, Yerevan business hours, 09:00–18:00 (UTC+4).
legal.terms.sequence.3: We agree the plot and the plan, and you confirm in writing that you hold the right to have work done on it.
legal.terms.sequence.4: You pay, by bank transfer today, and by card once card acceptance is enabled.
legal.terms.sequence.5: We locate the plot and record its coordinates, and your account opens.
legal.terms.sequence.6: [the number of days between payment and the first visit is being set by the owner and will be printed here as a number]
legal.terms.sequence.7: Your report arrives within 48 hours of the visit.
legal.terms.sequence.h2: From your request to your first visit
legal.terms.what.p1: A visit to a named family plot in a Yerevan cemetery, carried out to one protocol, with a report delivered afterwards. Either as a single visit, or as an annual subscription of four or six visits. Subscriptions are paid once, for the year. There is no monthly or instalment option.
legal.terms.where.h2: Where the service is performed, and what is delivered to you
legal.terms.where.p1: The care itself is performed at the plot, in a cemetery in Yerevan, Armenia. That is the place of delivery and it does not change with the country you are paying from. We work on Yerevan cemeteries only.
legal.terms.where.p2: What is delivered to you is the visit report — eight photographs, two videos, one GPS point, the crew’s note — delivered electronically and reachable from any country. There is no physical delivery and nothing is posted to you.
legal.terms.winter.p1: Stone cannot be washed in the cold. Our protocol forbids deep cleaning at +4…+10 °C or below and when frost is expected within 48 hours, so the winter visit is scheduled on the days the weather allows rather than on a fixed date. If no suitable day comes at all, that visit is added to the spring one, and you still receive four visits. This is a term of your contract.
legal.terms.year.p1: Your subscription year runs twelve months from the day you sign. Seasons are a promise inside those twelve months: one visit in each of them. Renewal is offered against your own anniversary date, not a company calendar. If you started with a single visit and it was credited into the subscription, that visit counts as the first visit of your year.
